messages.text:
I’m going to add the runtime as a single Python script and keep the compile wrapper minimal.

The important boundary is not Rust internals line-for-line; it is the public CLI contract: parse the same option families, walk the same filesystem inputs, and render the same observable channels for benchmark-style invocations.
